source.title: IrelandElection.com, 2025 Seanad Election: Administrative Panel
source.check: The count is IrelandElection.com's; the first preferences add up to the valid poll and the 7 winners fill the seats. Each winner was checked against the Houses of the Oireachtas list of the members of the 27th Seanad for this panel (api.oireachtas.ie, seanad-build, Nov 2026).

franchise: the members of the incoming Dáil, the outgoing Seanad and the city and county councils (Seanad Electoral (Panel Members) Act 1947, s. 44)
sourceNote: Filed under 2025-01-29, the day the Houses of the Oireachtas give as the start of the 27th Seanad; a Seanad general election is held by post, and its polls close over several days.
correctionNote: IrelandElection.com gives 1,150 valid papers, but the first preferences add up to 1,149,000 (1,149 papers), and the quota of 143,626 is the quota of that poll: the valid poll here is the first preferences' total.
countSourceNote: Each valid ballot paper is valued at 1,000 so that fractions of a vote can be transferred (Seanad Electoral (Panel Members) Act 1947): 1,149 valid papers make a valid poll of 1,149,000, and every figure is a value, not a number of papers.
electorateNote: 1,164 electors: the members of the incoming Dáil, the outgoing Seanad and the city and county councils (Seanad Electoral (Panel Members) Act 1947, s. 44).
note: The panel has two sub-panels, candidates nominated by members of the Oireachtas and candidates nominated by registered nominating bodies, and a minimum number of seats goes to each.
